name: Sariel's Day Out
source:
You are a silly angel boy who is just so sick and tired of working day in and day out! So you decide to slack off a little bit. Absolutely nothing can go wrong! It's just a little break, right? Right?

[From [url=https://angeluscult.itch.io/sariels-day-out]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是個有點傻氣的天使男孩，日復一日地工作，真是受夠了！於是你決定偷一點點懶。絕對不可能出什麼岔子！就休息一下下，對吧？對吧？

［摘自[url=https://angeluscult.itch.io/sariels-day-out]itch.io[/url]］
